Item 8.01 Other Events.

During the period between October 27, 2026 and November 2, 2026, Example Treasury Corp (the “Company”) acquired approximately 4,250 bitcoins for approximately $425.3 million in cash, or approximately $100,071 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees and expenses.

As of November 2, 2026, the Company held an aggregate of approximately 52,000 bitcoins, which were acquired at an aggregate purchase price of approximately $4.1 billion.

The Company also sold 120 BTC at an average price of $101,000 per bitcoin for tax purposes.
